Where your dinner comes from

We know the farm.
Now you can too.

Our lamb is South Downs and Herstmonceux. Our beef is from the Weald. Our game comes from the county's own estates. Nothing travels far, and nothing arrives without a name behind it.

Made on site

Sausages, handmade.
New flavours weekly.

Our sausages are made here, by hand, from quality local pork and the finest ingredients. The range changes every week, so there is always a reason to see what is on.

Bacon dry-cured on the premises. Black pudding the proper way. The things a supermarket cannot do, done the way they should be.

Our story

The name is not an accident. James learned his trade in Bright, Victoria, on the other side of the world, before he brought it home to Terminus Road.

He trained as a butcher over twenty years ago in the town of Bright, in Victoria, Australia, and opened his own shop there. When the family settled in Eastbourne, the craft came with them, and Victoria Butchers was named for where it began.

What has not changed is the belief underneath it. Buy well, from people you know. Support the farms down the road. Sell meat you would happily put in front of your own family, because most weeks, you do.

JamesOwner, Victoria Butchers of Eastbourne
